titel: Storming the Capital (with Abdul and JB)

einzeiler: Democrats analyze a historic midterm victory and discuss what comes next in Washington.
kurzfassung: Following a historic electoral defeat for Republicans in the midterms, the hosts discuss the underlying factors driving the results and the shifting political landscape. Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed joins the show to discuss his historic win, foreign policy, and his priorities for the Senate. Later, Illinois Governor J.B. Pritzker stops by to talk about state-level strategies, congressional fights, and the future of the Democratic party.
stichpunkte: Democrats achieved major electoral gains in the midterms, winning significant majorities in the House and Senate.
Donald Trump's post-election response focused on building a lavish ballroom rather than addressing the historic losses.
Leaked reports highlight internal chaos and failed strategies among Trump aides during the midterm campaign.
Voter turnout surged among young voters, Black voters in the South, and Latino voters, fueling Democratic victories.
Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed discusses his victory, his approach to challenging political bullies, and his foreign policy stance on Israel.
Democratic leadership outlines an agenda focused on healthcare protection, ending foreign conflicts, and lowering costs.
Republican figures grapple with the potential end of the Trump era and jockey for position ahead of 2028.

clips.text: A humorous correlation is noted between Democratic vote overperformance and counties containing a Cheesecake Factory.

clips.hook: Caffeine overdose on the campaign trail
clips.text: An anecdote is shared about a campaign staffer accidentally drinking undiluted cold brew concentrate and experiencing severe shakes.

clips.hook: The impossibility of JD Vance's political tightrope
clips.text: The hosts mock the contradictory strategy of trying to serve as Donald Trump's vice president while simultaneously distancing oneself for a future presidential run.
Governor Pritzker contrasts massive outside spending by billionaires with his own modest campaign investment, highlighting the return on investment.

beschreibung: Live from DC, Jon, Lovett, Tommy, Alex, and Dan break down all the latest news from the aftermath of Democrats’ huge wins on Tuesday, from JD Vance’s attempted break with Trump to what the incoming majorities’ top priorities should be. Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed drops by to talk about standing up to Donald Trump, building consensus on saving Americans’ health care, and his eye-opening caffeine regimen. Then, Gov. JB Pritzker outlines a plan for standing up for working Americans, why Elon Musk’s millions didn’t get results, and why Democrats shouldn’t unilaterally disarm in the redistricting fight. Then, Pritzker joins the hosts for a round of Two Takes and a Fake, featuring the right’s most outrageous reactions to the blue tsunami.
